disconnectedBannerMessage: Termux is disconnected. Shell, Git, and agent sessions are paused until you reconnect.
disconnectedWorkOpsBlocked: Termux is disconnected. Reconnect from the banner, then try again.
setupClearConfirmBody: This removes saved Termux keys and username. You will need to set up Termux again.
setupConnectFailedWithDetail: Could not connect to Termux: {detail: String}
setupDownloadFailed: Could not download Termux. Retry or use a store link.
setupInstallDenied: Install was cancelled or blocked. Enable unknown apps if needed, then retry.
setupIntro: Install Termux, paste one setup script, then connect TeamPilot to the local SSH server.
setupScriptHint: Allow storage access when prompted. sshd is enabled via termux-services (starts when Termux opens). Optional: install Termux:Boot from F-Droid for reboot without opening Termux. The last line prints your username (e.g. u0_a399).
setupUsernameError: Enter a valid Termux username (starts with u)
